title: why indian govt hates comedians?
description:
Many Indian comedians today are being criticized for crossing the line between humor and insensitivity. In the race to be edgy or viral, jokes often target religion, regional identities, or sensitive social issues without thought for consequences. What starts as satire sometimes turns into casual disrespect, hurting sentiments and widening divides.  

While comedy should have the freedom to question and provoke thought, the lack of balance and increasing reliance on shock value is concerning. True comedy challenges power without punching down—but when done irresponsibly, it risks alienating audiences and eroding the quality of the art itself.
